name: dev-digest-ai-marketplace
description: Team AI harness extracted from DevDigest: a spec-driven development workflow plus the engineering practices, research and architecture-review plugins it depends on.

plugins.name: engineering-paved-path
plugins.description: Shared engineering skills: layered (onion) architecture, Fastify, Drizzle ORM, PostgreSQL table design and Zod.

plugins.name: research-tools
plugins.description: Read-only researcher agent that answers codebase and external-documentation questions with file:line and URL evidence.

plugins.name: architecture-review
plugins.description: Read-only architecture reviewer agent that checks a change against the repository's own architecture docs and the shared engineering skills.

plugins.name: sdd-engineering
plugins.description: Spec-driven development workflow: spec-creator, implementation-planner, implementer and plan-verifier agents orchestrated by /run-plan, with approval gates, evals and a token retrospective.
